title: Verify identifier cannot be changed after creation
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Attempt to change an existing identifier
    Given an identifier "ID123" is created
    When I attempt to change the identifier to "ID456"
    Then the system should reject the change with an error message "Identifier cannot be changed"
rationale: To ensure that once an identifier is created, it remains unchanged, which is critical for data integrity.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Check identifier remains the same after creation
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Verify identifier value after creation
    Given an identifier "ID123" is created
    When I retrieve the identifier
    Then the identifier value should be "ID123"
rationale: To confirm that the identifier retains its original value post-creation, ensuring immutability.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Ensure system logs an error when changing identifier
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Log error on identifier change attempt
    Given an identifier "ID123" is created
    When I attempt to change the identifier to "ID456"
    Then an error should be logged with the message "Identifier cannot be changed"
rationale: To verify that the system logs an appropriate error when an immutability violation occurs.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Test identifier creation with unique value
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Create unique identifier
    Given no existing identifier with value "ID123"
    When I create an identifier with value "ID123"
    Then the identifier should be created successfully
rationale: To ensure that identifiers can be created uniquely and are immutable thereafter.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Verify multiple identifiers can coexist
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Create multiple unique identifiers
    Given no existing identifiers
    When I create identifiers "ID123" and "ID456"
    Then both identifiers should be created successfully and remain unchanged
rationale: To confirm that multiple identifiers can exist independently while adhering to immutability.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Check identifier cannot be deleted and recreated with same value
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Attempt to delete and recreate identifier
    Given an identifier "ID123" is created
    When I delete the identifier and attempt to recreate it with the same value
    Then the system should reject the recreation with an error message "Identifier already exists"
rationale: To ensure that identifiers cannot be deleted and recreated, maintaining their immutability.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Ensure identifier is immutable across sessions
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Verify identifier immutability across sessions
    Given an identifier "ID123" is created in one session
    When I access the identifier in a new session
    Then the identifier value should still be "ID123"
rationale: To confirm that identifiers remain immutable regardless of session state.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Test identifier creation with invalid value
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Attempt to create identifier with invalid value
    Given an invalid identifier value "" (empty string)
    When I attempt to create an identifier
    Then the system should reject the creation with an error message "Invalid identifier value"
rationale: To ensure that only valid identifiers can be created, reinforcing the immutability rule.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Check identifier uniqueness constraint
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Attempt to create duplicate identifier
    Given an identifier "ID123" is created
    When I attempt to create another identifier with value "ID123"
    Then the system should reject the creation with an error message "Identifier already exists"
rationale: To ensure that identifiers are unique and immutable, preventing duplicates.
generationSummary: Tests for the immutability of identifiers to ensure they cannot be changed after creation.

title: Verify identifier cannot be modified by different users
gherkin:
Feature: Identifier immutability
  Scenario: Attempt to modify identifier by different user
    Given an identifier "ID123" is created by User A
    When User B attempts to change the identifier to "ID456"
    Then the system should reject the change with an error message "Identifier cannot be changed"
rationale: To ensure that immutability is enforced regardless of user permissions or roles.
